name: france_travail-mcp
description: France Travail (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_france_travail_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FRANCE_TRAVAIL_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_france_travail_client_id.description: Identifiant client of a francetravail.io application subscribed to the 'Offres d'emploi' API (create it at https://francetravail.io/inscription, then add the API to the application).

platform_mcp_france_travail_client_secre.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FRANCE_TRAVAIL_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_france_travail_client_secre.description: Clé secrète of the same francetravail.io application.

tools.name: search
tools.description: GET /v2/offres/search ('Rechercher par critères'). motsCles is the keyword filter (each keyword at least 2 characters, several separated by commas). The place filters take INSEE codes (commune, departement, region), so location/country are not sent. Paging is the `range` parameter 'p-d' (first-last index, at most 150 per call); the runtime cannot compute the end index, so `range` is not sent and the platform's default window (the first 150 offers) is returned — `page` and `limit` are ignored. The total is only in the Content-Range header, so total is null. HTTP 206 (partial list) is a success; an empty search answers 204 (no postings). Salary is a label (salaire.libelle, in raw), not numbers.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v2/offres/{offerId} ('Consulter une offre', offerId is the 7-character offer id, e.g. 048KLTP). origineOffre.urlOrigine is the offer's page on francetravail.fr; e-mail contacts are masked by the platform (apply through that page). salaire.libelle, typeContrat and the rest stay in raw.
